newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AWB Australian wheat Indicator prices-Sept 12.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AWB Australian wheat Indicator prices-Sept 12.

text.p: World prices for milling and durum wheat fell sharply overnight in response to the USDA estimate which forecast greater than anticipated rises in world wheat and corn production, the Australian Wheat Board said.
Wheat Indicator prices for multi-grade contracts 96/97 fell by A$6.00 per tonne. The Durum price fell by A$7.00.
Prices, FOB, in A$ per tonne:

NOTE: The indicator price represents the current state of the international wheat market. It is a cash contract price offered today by the AWB for wheat delivered during the 1996/97 harvest. The offer is valid until 4.30 p.m. Australian Eastern Standard Time (0630 GMT) and Eastern Standard Summer Time (0530 GMT). Indicator prices will be revised daily until October.
